verdict.rationale: A scheduling SaaS could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies, but the evidence pack shows none. "Delegate access to an assistant" refers to a human assistant with their own login, not an AI. The MCP integration lets external AI clients such as Claude or ChatGPT connect to SavvyCal, which is a different capability from an assistant built into the product, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
